_comment: Weight manifest. Each repo is pinned to a Hugging Face revision; scripts/download_models.py
fetches only the files listed in `files` (glob patterns) into models/<name> (gitignored), and
models.lock.json pins every file's size and SHA256. Weights are NOT redistributed by this repo:

repos.name: sa3-small-sfx
repos.role: engine: Stable Audio 3 Small-SFX (44.1 kHz stereo, 8 steps)
repos.licence: Stability AI Community License (+ Gemma Terms for T5Gemma)

repos.name: aesthetics
repos.role: check: Meta Audiobox Aesthetics (production quality, artefacts)

repos.name: captioner
repos.role: optional: MiDashengLM 0.6B audio captioner (describes what a take actually contains)
